items.claim: CFO表示對未來3-5年exabyte成長率將超過25%的信心越來越強。
items.quote: the exabyte growth over the next 3 to 5 years will be greater than 25%
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO重申2月Innovation Day揭示的未來3-5年毛利率目標為逾50%。
items.quote: gross margins in the next 3 to 5 years will be greater than 50%
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO揭露上季平均每TB售價（ASP/TB）年增9%。
items.quote: our average ASP per terabyte was up 9% on a year-over-year basis
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO表示中長期每TB成本可望年降約10%。
items.quote: costs will come down on or about 10% year-over-year on a cost per terabyte basis
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO以年增率衡量增量毛利率，指出落在70%-75%區間。
items.quote: It's in the 70%, 75% range
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO指出自由現金流利潤率已逼近30%。
items.quote: the free cash flow margin is approaching 30%
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO指出硬碟業與記憶體業訂價機制不同，記憶體側是供需驅動且波動更劇烈。
items.quote: The memory side is more of a supply-demand driven pricing
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO描述客戶群中約80%資料存放於HDD、約20%存放於SSD，且兩個區隔都在強勁成長。
items.quote: roughly 80% of all the data is being stored on HDD and roughly 20% or so is stored on SSD
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明公司選擇把絕大部分自由現金流透過股票回購方案還給股東。
items.quote: the vast majority of the free cash flow is being returned through the share buyback program
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO表示公司幾乎每天都在回購股票，對估值判斷沒有猶豫。
items.quote: We're buying back almost every day
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO證實公司已就16億美元可轉債的一大部分，與部分票據持有人達成私下交換協議，本金付現、溢價付股票。
items.quote: we did a private exchange with a good chunk of that $1.6 billion of the note holders and will pay the principal in cash and pay the premium in shares
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO指出長期資本支出對營收比將維持在4%-6%，用於投資磁頭與媒材。
items.quote: in the long term, 4% to 6% of CapEx to revenue, we will have to spend that in head and media
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明上季出貨平均每碟容量約23TB，同時32TB產品已在高量出貨。
items.quote: The average terabyte per drive that we shipped last quarter was on or about 23 terabytes
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明公司正同步驗證下一代ePMR（可達40TB）與第一代HAMR（可達44TB）產品。
items.quote: qualification of our first-generation HAMR drives that will go up to 44-terabyte
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO指出公司具備通往50、60、70甚至100TB以上容量的多年產品路線圖。
items.quote: we have a path to 50 or 60 or 70 or 100 or plus 100-terabyte drives
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO開場依例揭露前瞻性聲明存在風險與不確定性，可能導致實際結果與預期有重大差異。
items.quote: risks and uncertainties could cause actual results to differ materially from expectations
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO描述目前業務結構中雲端客戶佔90%，消費與客戶端各佔5%，與過去以OEM為主的結構已大不相同。
items.quote: 90% of my business is cloud, still 5% consumer and 5% client
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明公司已教育大多數客戶提前52週下採購訂單，因而對至少一年內的需求有相對良好的能見度。
items.quote: most of our customers, they place purchase orders now 52 weeks in advance
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO表示透過與客戶的緊密協作，公司對出貨的硬碟正被快速部署到資料中心有很好的能見度。
items.quote: we have great visibility that all the hard disk drives we are shipped are being deployed as fast as they practically can do it
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明部分客戶要求的LTA長約一路延伸至2032年，即5年期長約。
items.quote: they want to have LTAs all the way till 2032, 5 years LTAs
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明LTA內含量與價的條款，但保留一定彈性，並非完全鎖死。
items.quote: a volume component and a price component in there with some flexibility
items.speaker: Kris Sennesael (CFO)

qa_flags.question: what would it take for Western Dig to actually add more units to the ecosystem?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO未給出具體加產能的門檻數字，改以「我把「大於25%」到底是多少留給你自己判斷」帶過，只重申現有假設下可不靠新增單位產能來支撐成長。

qa_flags.question: Any closing comments...tell us how great greater than 20 really means?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO明確表示「我把這個留給投資人自己去想清楚」，未把「greater than 25%」的具體數字或上限講清楚，僅重申需求預測持續上修、公司處於有利位置。
